senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (अटति)
To move, to go or approach:
with परि prefixed,
to go round about, to roam, to rove, to ramble, to wander about, especially as a religious mendicant.
10th cl. (अटयति)
To slight.

mf. (-टः-टा)
1 Going.
2 Roaming, wandering.
E.
अट, and अच् aff.

r. 1st cl. (उ.) (अटृते)
1 To surpass or excel, to transgress or exceed.
2 To kill or hurt.
10th cl. (अट्टयति)
1 To slight.
2 To be small.

m. (-ट्टः)
1 A room on the top of the house; but it is also applicable to other structures; as the back of an edifice, a fortified place in front of a building, a room on the top of a temporary hall, or a particular kind of building.
2 Much, excessive.
n. (-ट्टं)
Food, boiled rice especially.
mfn. (-ट्टः-ट्टा-ट्टं)
Dry, dried.
E.
अट्ट to go, surpass, or transcend, and घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Going.
2 Roaming about, leading a vagrant life.
E.
अट, and ल्युट् aff.

n. (-नं)
A circular weapon, a kind of discus.
E.
अट्ट to kill or hurt, ल्युट् aff.

f. (-निः or नी)
The notched extremity of a bow.
E.
अट to go, अनि affix, also with ङीष fem. termination.

m. (-षः)
A tree, (Justicia adhatoda.)
E.
अट here, disease, from अट to go, and रुष to destroy; destroying disease.

m. (-षः)
See the last word.

m. (-षः)
A tree, (Justicia adhenatoda, &c.)
E.
see अटरुष, the अ being made long.

f. (-विः)
A forest, or wood.
E.
अट to go, and अवि affix^1, or ङीष् being added अटवी ut infra; birds, &c. resting there.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20230726. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-orig/issues/1279.

f. (-वी)
A forest, or grove. See अटवि.

m. (-कः)
A wood-man, a forester.
E.
अटवि a wood, ठक aff.

m. (-कः)
A wood-man.
E.
अटवी a wood, and ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Immoveable, unchangeable.

m. (-लः)
An upper room or pavilion, on the flat roof of an Indian house.
E.
अट्ट much, and अल to adorn.

f. (-ट्या)
Roaming about as a devotee or religious mendicant.
E.
अट to go, frequentative form, affs. अच् and यप्

ind.
Very lofty.

m. (-सः)
Violent laughter, a horse-laugh.
E.
अट्ट excessive, and हास a laugh.

m. (-कः)
A plant, (Jasminum multiflorum.)
E.
अट्टहास, and कन्; resembling a laugh or smile on beauty's countenance; the comparison is common to the poets.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
Laughing, loudly and violently.
m. (-सी)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
अट्टहास, and णिनि poss. aff.

m. (-कः)
A room on the top of the house.
E.
अट्ट much, अल to adorn, and कन् aff.

f. (-का)
A palace, an upper-roomed house.
E.
as before, fem. form.

m. (-रः)
A bricklayer, a mason, a builder; born of a Śūdra mother and painter father.
E.
अट्टालिका, and कार who enables.
